title: The AI Revolution Fails Without Psychological Safety For Developers: A Conversation with Erin Doyle
gist: Quotient founding engineer Erin Doyle tells Michael Stiefel that AI coding tools have shifted engineers from writing code to architecture, review and context-setting, and that adoption succeeds only with psychological safety and team alignment rather than token-usage mandates. She warns the industry has no plan to train junior engineers, that review has become the new bottleneck, and that humans must keep full liability for AI output.

themes.theme: Work shifts to architecture and context
